clips.title: The story
paras: At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield seeks Gaea seeds to help heal Stonetalon. She asks the Horde to gather the rare seeds from Mirkfallon Lake, hoping to bless them and restore the mountain’s damaged soil.

Stonetalon’s peaks bear wounds from commercial exploitation and regional conflict. Logging and clashes between rival factions have left forests scorched, cut down, or reduced to ash. For the tauren stationed at Sun Rock Retreat, the rapid destruction of the natural world is a grievous wound. Shamans like Tammra Windfield seek the Earthmother’s restorative cycle as they work to mend the land.

Tammra seeks rare Gaea seeds around Mirkfallon Lake, north of Sun Rock Retreat. The lake’s banks nurture sturdy seed pods along the water’s edge. These seeds have a resilience unique to Stonetalon, though danger surrounds the region. Once they are gathered, Tammra channels ancestral shamanistic blessings into each kernel, awakening its power to speed its growth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.
Friend, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.
Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, friend, you have the Gaea seeds. Watch and see how the blessing of the Earthmother can cause even these small kernels of life to bloom and flourish.
